summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Enterprise Java Full Stack Capstone Project. Integrates the Spring Boot backend with a responsive, modern HTML5+JS/React SPA frontend (served directly from Spring Boot), adds Springdoc OpenAPI / Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html with JWT Bearer security scheme, leverages existing @ControllerAdvice global exception handling, and provides end-to-end architecture and setup documentation in README.md.
